final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS ob, AVG(f.feerate) AS a FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY o.orderbase), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) AS b FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ob AS c1, s1.a AS c2, s1.a - s2.b AS c3 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.b) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3) FROM s3
